t: What Does The Name Aomy Mean?
s: In Thai, “Aom” (ออม) means to save, conserve, or cherish, conveying ideas of prudence and care; “Aomy” can be understood as an affectionate or stylistically modernized form of Aom, sometimes spelled Aommy or Omy in Latin transcription. Because Thai nicknaming practices favor short, mellifluous forms, common diminutives and pet forms include Aom, Om, Aommy, and Mimi.
